 Thu, 29 October 2026 
 By TRN Online, Kathmandu, Oct 29: Kathmandu Gorkhas set 116 runs target for Janakpur Bolts in the Nepal Premier League Season (NPL) Seasons-3 match being played at Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur, today.  
 Kathmandu Gorkhas' Bhim Sharki scored 33 runs in 29 balls, Rashid Khan scored 17 runs in 14 balls, Smit Patel scored 13 runs in 13 balls, Sumit Maharjan scored 10 runs in 9 balls, Sam Heazlett scored 1 run in 3 balls, Harishankar Shah scored 9 runs in 8 balls, Jahandad Khan scored 5 runs in 8 balls, Ripon Mondal scored 9 runs in 8 balls, Shahab Alam scored 4 runs in 6 balls to put a total of 115 runs in 19.3 overs. 
 For Janakpur Bolts, Rahul Yadav took 4 wickets, Saif Hassan took 2 wickets, Moeen Ali and Harmeet Singh took 2 wickets.
